name: Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 (Act 51 of 2007)

sections.title: Authorisation of payment systems
sections.text_summary: Empowers RBI to issue guidelines authorising payment systems. The RBI's TReDS Guidelines are issued under this authority. See [TREDS](/schemes/TREDS.md).

source.page_or_section_ref: RBI TReDS Guidelines, cited legal basis

_body:
## Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007

Minimal stub, authored only to the extent needed to ground TReDS's stated
legal basis ("[TReDS guidelines are] issued by Reserve Bank of India under
Section 10(2) read with Section 18 of Payment & Settlement Systems Act,
2007"). Not independently fetched or verified beyond that one citing
sentence on the RBI TReDS page — do not treat this as a general-purpose
summary of the Act.
